The name is also associated with the night and day, as Chandbibi is said to have been a woman who would observe the night and day and would pray at both times. In Arabic, the name Chandbibi means 'care and protection of the night and day', and is a name that is associated with the concept of 'rahma', or mercy. In Islamic tradition, the name Chandbibi is also associated with the concept of 'izzah', or honor, and is considered a name that brings good fortune and prosperity to those who bear it. The name Chandbibi is also associated with the Quranic verse 'And We have certainly honored the children of Adam', which speaks of the honor and dignity that is bestowed upon human beings by Allah.
